title: send_message params
description: Sends a message on an established session. The send runs after the command is read, and messages on one session are sent, stored and reported with message_sent in the order of their commands. A send that fails is not tried again and fails with send_message_failed: with reason connection_lost when the connection is gone, so that the message was not delivered (a dialed session then reconnects, see session_reconnecting, and a server session ends), and with reason message_too_large when the message is over the protocol's or the relay's limit, which leaves the session usable.
